app.name: Google Pay: Save, Pay, Manage
app.description: A simple and secure way to pay in stores, apps, and online, send money to friends, and manage your finances.

verdict.one_liner: Google stores your payment info and may use purchase activity for personalized ads.
verdict.summary: Google Pay is a digital wallet that requires a Google Account. The Google Privacy Policy states that payment information may be added to your account and that purchase activity is collected as part of your activity across Google services. Google says it may show personalized ads based on your activity across services depending on your settings. Your data is shared with trusted external businesses for processing and non-personally identifiable information is shared with partners including advertisers.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Google Pay is convenient, but Google stores your payment information and tracks your purchase activity. Depending on your settings, this activity may be used for personalized ads across Google services. For maximum financial privacy, consider using your bank's direct payment app or Apple Pay instead.

red.title: Payment information is stored in your Google Account
red.plain_english: Google's privacy policy states that you can add payment information to your Google Account. When you are signed in, Google stores information with your account and treats it as personal information.

red.title: Purchase activity is collected and may be used for ads
red.plain_english: Google's privacy policy lists 'Purchase activity' as part of the activity information it collects. The policy states that depending on your settings, Google may show you personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services.

red.title: Personal information is shared with trusted businesses
red.plain_english: Google's privacy policy states that it provides personal information to affiliates and other trusted businesses or persons to process it for Google. This includes service providers that help operate data centers and deliver products and services.

red.title: Your Google Pay activity is linked to your Google Account
red.plain_english: Google's privacy policy states that when you are signed in, information is collected and stored with your Google Account and treated as personal information. This links your payment and purchase activity to your broader Google identity.

green.title: Encryption is used to protect data
green.plain_english: Google's privacy policy states that it uses encryption to keep your data private while in transit.

green.title: You can delete your information and manage privacy settings
green.plain_english: Google provides controls to delete content from specific services, delete specific products, or delete your entire Google Account. You can also export a copy of your content.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Google Pay does not access your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: No camera or microphone access is mentioned in the privacy policy for Google Pay.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Google's privacy policy states that location information is collected when you use its services. It does not clearly explain whether Google Pay specifically uses your location.
categories.detail: The general Google Privacy Policy says location is collected for driving directions, search results, and ads. It does not specifically mention how Google Pay uses location data.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect location information when you use our services, which helps us offer features like driving directions, search results for things near you, and ads based on your location.
concerns: Policy does not clearly explain Google Pay's specific use of location

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The Google Privacy Policy does not state that Google Pay accesses your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: While the general policy mentions contact suggestions for some Google services, there is no specific mention of Google Pay reading your phonebook or contacts list.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Google Pay does not access your personal files or photos.
categories.detail: No file system access is mentioned in the privacy policy for Google Pay.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Google's privacy policy states that personal information is shared with affiliates and trusted businesses for external processing, and non-personally identifiable information is shared with partners including advertisers.
categories.detail: The policy says Google does not share personal information outside of Google except with consent, domain administrators, for external processing, or for legal reasons. However, it also says non-personally identifiable information may be shared publicly and with partners like publishers, advertisers, and developers.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not share your personal information with companies, organizations, or individuals outside of Google except in the following cases: With your consent; With domain administrators; For external processing; For legal reasons. We may share non-personally identifiable information publicly and with our partners — like publishers, advertisers, developers, or rights holders.
concerns: Personal information shared with trusted external processors
Non-personally identifiable information shared with advertisers and partners

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You need a Google Account to use Google Pay. Google links your payment activity to your identity and other Google services.
categories.detail: Google Account required. The policy states that when you create an account, you provide personal information including your name and password, and you can add a phone number or payment information. When signed in, information is stored with your Google Account.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create a Google Account, you provide us with personal information that includes your name and a password. You can also choose to add a phone number or payment information to your account. When you're signed in, we also collect information that we store with your Google Account, which we treat as personal information.
concerns: Payment activity linked to Google identity

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Google tracks purchase activity and may use it to personalize ads across Google services depending on your settings.
categories.detail: The policy lists 'Purchase activity' as collected activity information. It says depending on your settings, Google may show personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services. Google says it does not use sensitive categories for ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: The activity information we collect may include: Purchase activity. Depending on your settings, we may also show you personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services. We don't show you personalized ads based on sensitive categories, such as race, religion, sexual orientation, or health.
concerns: Activity may be used for personalized ads

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Google requires users to be 13 or older for a Google Account. Google Accounts for children under 13 are managed with Family Link.
categories.detail: Standard Google age requirement of 13+. Payment services typically require adult consent. The policy mentions Google Accounts Managed with Family Link for children under 13.
categories.policy_excerpt: Google Accounts Managed with Family Link, for Children under 13 (or applicable age in your country).

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Google logs your IP address, device info, and system activity continuously when you use Google services.
categories.detail: The policy states that Google collects information about the interaction of your apps, browsers, and devices with its services, including IP address, crash reports, and system activity.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about the interaction of your apps, browsers, and devices with our services, including IP address, crash reports, system activity, and the date, time, and referrer URL of your request.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Google collects detailed device information including unique identifiers, operating system, and carrier information.
categories.detail: The policy says Google collects unique identifiers, browser type, device type and settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, and application version number.
categories.policy_excerpt: The information we collect includes unique identifiers, browser type and settings, device type and settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, and application version number.
concerns: Carrier name and phone number collected

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Google Pay does not collect health or biometric data, though you may use biometric authentication on your device to unlock the app.
categories.detail: Biometric authentication on the device is handled locally by the operating system. The Google Privacy Policy does not mention collecting biometric data for Google Pay.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Google's privacy policy states that payment information can be added to your Google Account and that purchase activity is collected.
categories.detail: Payment information may be added to your Google Account. Purchase activity is listed as collected activity information. Google says it may use this information to verify age requirements.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can also choose to add a phone number or payment information to your account. The activity information we collect may include: Purchase activity.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can remove payment methods and delete your Google Pay activity, but Google may retain some data for legal and financial record-keeping.
categories.detail: The policy states that some data is retained for longer periods when necessary for legitimate business or legal purposes, such as security, fraud and abuse prevention, or financial record-keeping.
categories.policy_excerpt: And some data we retain for longer periods of time when necessary for legitimate business or legal purposes, such as security, fraud and abuse prevention, or financial record-keeping.
concerns: Transaction data retained for financial record-keeping
Some data kept after deletion for legal purposes

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Google promises not to reduce your rights under its Privacy Policy without your explicit consent, and it provides more prominent notice for significant changes.
categories.detail: The general Google Privacy Policy states it will not reduce your rights without explicit consent, and provides more prominent notice for significant changes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We change this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent. If changes are significant, we'll provide a more prominent notice.
